name: Orbit ribbon commons
idea: A collaborative airborne workspace formed as a welcoming loop around a suspended shared cabin rather than as a car, aircraft, or room with softened corners.
shape_ancestry: one inflated toroidal ribbon folds around a pearl-like inhabited cavity, combining a continuous loop, suspended inner volume, and open center
silhouette: a broad soft loop sweeps upward and around one smaller hanging cabin, leaving a large intentional opening that makes the object recognizable at thumbnail size
exaggeration: make the enclosing loop dramatically wider than the cabin and stretch its upper arc into a buoyant directional gesture
aperture_rule: treat the loop's open center and one convex cabin window as integrated functional negative spaces; use no flat windshield or black display band
construction_cues: two warm docking bridges suspend the cabin from the enclosing loop
one continuous maintenance seam follows the loop curvature
one softly glowing underside cavity explains lift without exposed contemporary propulsion hardware
material_direction: powder-blue molded fiberglass, softly tinted bubble glass, warm brushed-metal bridge details, cream upholstery, and gentle illustrated surface grain
